headline: Expanse Lines Shift as Nevish Line Flares; Marban Still Contested
war_summary: Ground shifted in the Weathered Expanse, still the war's heaviest field: after forty-one actions in the day, Colonials now hold four of its nine works to three Warden and two unclaimed, an advance on the five Warden works reported at the last edition. The Nevish Line, quiet then, has flared again, eight actions in two hours against twenty-seven in the day, at a cost near 470 Colonial and 362 Warden casualties an hour; Wardens hold seven of its eight works. Marban Hollow stays hard-pressed, seven actions in six hours leaving its eight works three Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed, with fighting at Oster Wall reported to the hour. The Gutter has cooled sharply, two actions in two hours after nineteen in six, and now stands five Warden works and two unclaimed, its Colonial holding gone. Callahans Passage reports no ground won or lost but the day's heaviest toll: 11,643 Colonial and 8,244 Warden casualties. Colonials hold 304 works to 124 Warden, eight unclaimed.
